title: The Golden Cage
text: A golden birdcage hangs from a dead tree, swaying, though there is no wind. In it sits a grey bird with clever eyes. It speaks in your mother's voice, saying the things she used to say, and it knows your childhood name.

options.label: Open the golden cage, and set your mother's voice free.

outcomes.text: It flies off singing in your mother's voice. The song stays with you, kind.
It flies off laughing in a voice that was never your mother's at all.

options.label: Take the cage, bird and all. Gold is gold.

outcomes.text: The gold is very fine. The bird does not speak again, but it watches and waits.

options.label: The wisest listens to what it says, though it hurts to hear.

outcomes.text: It says something only your mother knew. Then it says something she never told anyone, and should not have.
